text:
GLS：同意移交 ALS 自动程序。
GLS, go for ALS.

好口令。火箭现在靠自己了。
Great call-out. The rocket is on its own.

四位勇敢的探索者，准备乘上
Four brave explorers, ready to ride

NASA 发射过的最强大的火箭。
the most powerful rocket NASA has ever launched.

约 10 天：绕过月球，再飞回来。
About ten days: around the Moon, and back.

消声水正在喷注。
Sound suppression water is flowing.

开始了。
And here we go.

十、九、八、七，
Ten, nine, eight, seven,

RS-25 发动机点火……
RS-25 engines lit…

四、三、二、一，助推器点火。
four, three, two, one, booster ignition.

阿尔忒弥斯二号乘组，正飞向月球。
The crew of Artemis II, now bound for the Moon.

人类下一段伟大航程，就此开始。
Humanity’s next great voyage begins.

下一个节点：助推器分离，T+2 分 09 秒。
Next on the clock: booster separation, at two minutes nine.

滚转、俯仰正常。
Good roll, pitch.

收到，滚转、俯仰。
Roger, roll, pitch.

休斯敦现在接管 Integrity 号的飞行，
Houston, now controlling the flight of Integrity

执行阿尔忒弥斯二号绕月任务。
on the Artemis II mission around the Moon.
